kv22.1:1.1: Atthi kiñci saññojanaṃ appahāya parinibbānan ti?
kv22.1:1.3: Atthi kiñci sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ appahāya --pe-- vicikicchaṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ rāgaṃ dosaṃ mohaṃ anottappaṃ appahāya parinibbānan ti?
kv22.1:2.1: Atthi kiñci saññojanaṃ appahāya parinibbānan ti?
kv22.1:2.3: Arahā sarāgo sadoso samoho samāno samakkho sapaḷāso sa-upāyāso sakileso ti?
kv22.1:2.5: Nanu Arahā nirāgo niddoso nimmoho nimmāno nimmakkho nippaḷāso nirūpāyāso nikkileso ti?
kv22.1:2.7: Hañci Arahā nirāgo niddoso nimmoho nimmāno nimmakkho nippaḷāso nirūpāyāso nikkileso, no vata re vattabbe
kv22.1:3.6: Tena hi atthi kiñci saññojanaṃ appahāya parinibbānan ti?
